name: Drone
short: A shruti box in your pocket.
about: A shruti-box style drone generator, tuned to just intonation. Pick a key, blend in the voices you want, add a little chaos. Presets for modal fiddle tunes, deep sleep and more.

name: Tunes
short: A smart tunebook for fiddlers: dots, chords and sets.
about: A tunebook for fiddlers. Searches thesession.org for dots and chords as you add tunes. Sort your list any way you like, make sets, play a drone in key.

name: Theory
short: An interactive music theory app for learning about modes, keys and chords.
about: Music theory you can turn in your hands. A wheel of scales, modes and chords, the circle of fifths and an ear game.

name: Little Guy
about: Generative ambient loopy guy. Capture a clip of wherever you are and let him run with it. Four mysterious sliders guide his movement, but who can say what they do?

name: Gas
short: A simple app to track fuel purchases, maintenance, and MPG over time. Shows you some cool graphs.
about: A mileage and maintenance tracker for your car. Tracks mpg and spend over time, shows you some cool graphs, reminds you when you need service.

name: Soup
short: 12 of my favorite soups to make in the Instant Pot.
about: Twelve of my favorite soups to make in my Instant Pot. Stovetop versions also.
